In pictures: Independence Day Vintage Classic Car Expo 2021
2021-04-02T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/shift/news/pictures-independence-day-vintage-classic-car-expo-2021-2070821

To celebrate 50 years of Independence, vintage car collectors of Dhaka hosted a classic car show at the capital's Baridhara Diplomatic Zone on Friday, March 26.

Organised by Durjoy Bangladesh Foundation , over 32 cars—from immaculately restored vintage to restomodded classics—were displayed at the event. Notable examples include a 1923 Austin 7, 1971 Dodge Charger R/T, 1967 BMW 2000 Tilux, 1940 Austin 12, 1977 FIAT X1/9 restomod, 1978 Mitsubishi Lancer and many more. Various pre-displacement limit era motorcycles were also put on show.

Photos: Shadman Al Samee
